text:
tom: quick flag from support: tenant saw overlapping billing rows after a reconnect + truncation. looks like confirmed charge didn't reconcile with the earlier provisional.

anya: can you paste trace ids? and was this toolcall-related or plain streaming?

tom: trace t=tr-559 sess=ss-9c, plain streaming, runtime truncated then resumed; logs show two separate provisional/confirm pairs for the same token offsets.

lee: pasted logs for tr-559:
```
2026-04-02T07:11:02Z ingress: open session sess=ss-9c provisional_tokens=160
2026-04-02T07:11:06Z runtime: stream-truncate emitted_prefix=48 reason=client_eof
2026-04-02T07:11:08Z router: handoff -> resume target=pool-d resume_offset=48
2026-04-02T07:11:09Z ledger: provisional_insert sess=ss-9c tokens=48 tag=pt-48-xyz
2026-04-02T07:11:12Z ledger: confirm_insert sess=ss-9c tokens=48
```

lee: the initial provisional (from before the truncation) wasn't tombstoned or aliased, so confirm_insert created a new confirmed row instead of updating.

sam: root cause is lack of stable id for prefix ranges across handoffs. we either need to (A) propagate a stable prefix_id from the first emission, or (B) teach ledger to detect and merge overlapping provisional ranges at confirm time.

anya: (A) seems better long-term. propose prefix_id = HMAC(router_salt, req_id || prefix_start). router generates at first emission and forwards in handoff RPC. ledger upserts by prefix_id.

tom: agree. short-term mitigation: console-side collapse heuristics for same session + overlapping ranges within 72h and show "collapsed suspected duplicate" with an expand link to raw ledger rows. reduces customer confusion while we roll server fix.

lee: telemetry plan: add counters billing.prov_upsert_attempts, billing.overlap_collapses, and a rate alert when overlap_collapses > 10/min in prod. also add a tag by tenant id so we can surface affected customers.

sam: migration notes: ledger needs index on prefix_id with TTL (keep 7 days). implement upsert endpoint confirm_by_prefix(prefix_id, tokens, finalized=true). fallback: if prefix_id absent, keep old insert flow. add integration tests for concurrent handoff where tombstone and resume race.

anya: reconciliation change: recon service currently expects insert_confirm events. make it accept confirm_upsert events keyed by prefix_id and emit an audit diff so external consumers don't break. add a small adapter for 30d.

billing-bot: created tracking ticket BILL-2026-201 and alert rule billing.overlap_collapses > 5/min.

tom: rollout plan: feature-flag prefix_id generation in router; enable ledger upsert behind flag; deploy console collapse read-side that honors prefix_id; flip flags in canary region, run for 48h, then grad roll.

lee: tests: unit tests for ledger.upsert, e2e sim of reconnect+resume asserting single merged final charge, chaos test with packet loss.

anya: small UX addition: in the merged row show a "why merged" tooltip explaining resume/truncate handoff and link to debug trace. ops can then directly jump to traces.

tom: i'll open the router PR and proto changes for handoff payload today. lee will own ledger changes; sam will do recon; anya will do console read-side. billing-bot please notify support so they can delay customer outreach until we have a reconciliation sweep.

billing-bot: support notified (ticket SUP-2026-690), will run a one-off recon merge for the last 72h and annotate affected invoices.

anya: one last note  for long-running sessions with multiple truncations, prefix_id must be per (req_id, prefix_start). do NOT reuse a single prefix_id per session. mention in proto doc.

lee: good call. i'll add that to tests. if more repros come in paste traces here.

tom: thanks all.
